capture: Native kriko-gpui window (debug build) on Linux, Weston's X11 backend inside Xvfb, Mesa lavapipe (software Vulkan). Captured with weston-screenshooter. Under bare Xvfb the window maps but presents no frames; Weston nested in Xvfb is what renders.
engine: python -m app.web with a throwaway HOME and KRIKO_PACK_INDEX pointed at a local packs.json built by packaging/publish_index.py from both repository catalogs.

observed.overview-first-run.png: Empty store: 'Packs you can install' lists both catalogs with Install; the packs card says to install one above; coverage gaps says gaps appear once a pack is installed. No false 'No record matches'.
observed.install: POST /api/packs/update for a not-installed pack (the Install button's job) installs it: 699 claims live, both offers then up_to_date.
observed.overview-installed.png: Pack names render ('Used cars', 'Cordless drills (example)'); they rendered as an ellipsis before. Install from a file and File quick looks sit on the packs card.
observed.home-installed.png: Claims per catalog shows both catalogs; with none installed it says so and links to Overview.
observed.agents.png: The install link under a missing agent renders; it rendered as an ellipsis before.
observed.sidebar: Browse shows the live product count (53) and Activity a badge only while jobs run; both were hardcoded mock values ('760', '1').
observed.browse-variant.png: A car variant opened by route (the panel's choose buttons): 104 claims apply, each naming the part it reaches through (engine, gearbox, electrics, body). Before, the drawer said no claim was stored.
observed.several: 'Volkswagen Golf 7 GTI 2.0 TSI DSG 2018' against the installed catalogs answers verdict 'several' with a choose step listing the variants; before it was 'recognised' and called a gap.
